events.title: First Representative Assembly Meets in Jamestown
events.description: In the choir of the Jamestown church in Virginia, colonists met for the first session of the General Assembly. It was the first representative legislative body in England's North American colonies.
events.significance: The assembly planted the seeds of representative self-government in what would become the United States.

events.title: Miguel Hidalgo Is Executed
events.description: Spanish colonial forces executed Miguel Hidalgo y Costilla in Chihuahua City. He was the priest who had launched the Mexican War of Independence.
events.significance: Hidalgo became a martyr and a national symbol, and the independence movement he began ended Spanish rule in Mexico.

events.title: Uruguay Wins the First FIFA World Cup
events.description: In Montevideo, the host nation Uruguay won the first FIFA World Cup final, which closed the tournament.
events.significance: The tournament started what became the world's most-watched sporting event.

events.title: Medicare Signed Into Law
events.description: President Lyndon B. Johnson signed Medicare into law at the Truman Library in Independence, Missouri. The program provides health insurance to older Americans.
events.significance: Medicare reshaped American health care and remains a cornerstone of the nation's social safety net.
